# routeros_app_settings (Resource)
Manage global App storage, networking, and registry settings on RouterOS 7.25.1 with the container package. Does not run the interactive setup wizard or format disks. Destroy leaves settings on the router. Import with any non-empty ID.

## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_app_settings" "settings" {
  # Select an already formatted, mounted disk; this resource does not format it.
  disk           = "sata1"
  lan_bridge     = "bridge"
  auto_update    = false
  show_in_webfig = true
}
```
